name: oeper.dev
description: Apps made by oeper, plus apps the community submitted and an owner approved.

apps.name: epic AI
apps.summary: oeper's own AI assistant: chat, read your screen, control your phone, talk, draw and work with your documents.
apps.description: epic AI answers questions, reads what is on your screen, can operate other apps for you, speaks and listens, draws pictures, remembers what you tell it and works with oneWord documents. On Android it can also be your phone's assistant. One account syncs your chats and memory across the website, the desktop apps and the phone app.
apps.author: oeper

apps.name: one
apps.summary: An office suite in your browser: documents, spreadsheets, slides, notes, PDFs, translation and more.
apps.description: one is oneWord, oneSheet, oneSlide, oneIdea, onePDF, oneLang (translator), oneDraw and oneSite in one installable web app. Files stay in your browser unless you turn on cloud saving to your oeper.dev account. Install it from your browser's menu to use it like an app.
apps.author: oeper

apps.name: Chess
apps.summary: Full-rules chess: pass-and-play, against a built-in AI, or live against another oeper.dev user.
apps.author: oeper

apps.name: Music Composer
apps.summary: Write a melody on a grid and play it back.
apps.author: oeper

apps.name: QR maker
apps.summary: Make QR codes for links, text and Wi-Fi, right in the browser.
apps.author: oeper

apps.name: Status+ (Pock widget)
apps.summary: A better status widget for the MacBook touch bar (needs Pock).
apps.description: Double-click Status.pock.zip to unzip it, then choose Status.pock and click Install Widget, then Install.
apps.author: oeper
